indexes._comment: Powers listMatchesByRole + subscribeMatchesByRole (sub-issue #99 of #20). The Matches tab (#21) renders matches scoped to the current Role, ordered by final_score desc. Composite on (owner_uid, role_id, final_score desc). owner_uid is part of every match query for cross-tenant safety; role_id is the per-Role scope; final_score desc is the rank order shown to the user. Without this index, Firestore rejects the orderBy + multiple where clauses combination.
